一群人怎麼一起發出聲音: how a group of people makes sound together
三到六人、由節奏組撐住時間、前線與節奏組即時協商的小型爵士編制。: Three to six players, with the rhythm section holding time while the frontline and the rhythm section negotiate in real time.
世界樂器合奏與編制百科 — 收錄 40 種合奏形式，從甘美朗、塔赫特到管弦樂團與: The World Sound ensemble encyclopedia — 40 line-ups, from gamelan and takht to the symphony orchestra and the big band, each explained through its division of roles, how its sound works, and where to start listening.
以五件原聲弦樂器分工、不用鼓、靠輪流獨奏推進的美國樂隊編制。: Five acoustic strings dividing the work, no drums, and the music pushed forward by taking solos in turn.
以克拉維為共同基準、由低音、鋼琴、打擊與銅管堆疊的加勒比舞曲編制。: A Caribbean dance line-up that takes the clave as its common reference, stacked with bass, piano, percussion and brass.
以兩支小號、次中音薩克斯風與低音聲部為核心，被整組聘來在節奏組上打點的銅管小組。: A small brass group of two trumpets, tenor sax and a low voice, hired as a unit to punch accents on top of the rhythm section.
以圍鼓為中心、鼓手兼指揮的緬甸古典合奏，用鼓聲說話。: A Burmese classical ensemble led from the drum circle: the drummer is also the conductor, and the drums do the talking.
以圖形譜、文字指示與即興約定運作的聲響團體，靠現場協商而非排練定的版本。: A sound group working from graphic scores, verbal instructions and improvisation agreements, settling things on the spot rather than rehearsing a fixed version.
以地域文化與傳統聲音系統為核心的合奏。重點在音律、調式與社群場合。: Ensembles built around a region's culture and its traditional sound system — tuning, modes and the occasions they play for.
以小提琴與小號奏旋律、維瑞拉與大吉他撐節奏的墨西哥樂隊編制。: The Mexican band where violins and trumpets carry the melody and vihuela and guitarron carry the rhythm.
以小提琴與欽巴隆為核心、靠裝飾音與滑音對話的羅馬尼亞羅姆樂隊。: A Romanian Romani band built on violin and cimbalom, holding a conversation in ornaments and slides.
以小鑼領奏的四件打擊樂編制，從村落行列走進音樂廳的韓國節慶鼓樂。: Four percussionists led by the small gong: Korean festival drumming that walked from village processions into the concert hall.
以巴拉萊卡與多姆拉家族為主體、由國家機構支撐的俄羅斯撥弦合奏。: A Russian plucked-string ensemble of balalaikas and the domra family, supported by state institutions.
以弦樂為底、木管銅管分層疊加的西方大型合奏體制。: The Western large-ensemble system: strings underneath, woodwind and brass layered on top.
以排簫與恰朗哥為核心、高原社群與節慶支撐的安地斯合奏。: Panpipes and charango at the core, sustained by highland communities and their festivals.
以擴充編制的銅管加上大鼓與小鼓，在婚禮與慶典中演奏不對稱節奏的樂隊。: An expanded brass section with bass and snare drum, playing asymmetric rhythms at weddings and festivals.
以改良樂器補齊音域與音量、同時容納正樂與民俗的韓國大型合奏。: A large Korean ensemble that fills out range and volume with modified instruments while accommodating both court music and folk music.
以曼陀林家族與吉他組成、用輪指代替弓弦的撥弦樂團。: A plucked-string orchestra of mandolins and guitars, using tremolo where a bow would go.
以木琴、圍鑼與雙面鼓為核心的泰國古典合奏，分硬調與軟調兩種音色。: The Thai classical ensemble of xylophone, gong circle and double-headed drum, in a hard or a soft timbre.
以板鼓領奏、鑼鈸應答的純打擊編制，靠口念的鑼鼓經記憶與排練。: A purely percussive line-up, led by the bangu board drum with gongs and cymbals answering, learned and rehearsed through spoken luogu mnemonics.
以歷史樂器、較低標準音高與無閥銅管重建舊作聲響的合奏體制。: A way of rebuilding old music's sound on historical instruments, at a lower pitch standard, with valveless brass.
以烏德、卡農與卡曼賈為核心的阿拉伯古典室內合奏。: The classical Arab chamber ensemble, built around oud, qanun and kamanja.
以箏、三味線、尺八為核心、在合奏與獨奏之間擺盪的日本傳統合奏。: A traditional Japanese ensemble built around koto, shamisen and shakuhachi, swinging between ensemble and solo.
以節奏組為引擎、以錄音與演出市場為前提的編制。: Line-ups driven by a rhythm section and built for the recording and live market.
以薩克斯風、小號、長號分組對抗，加上節奏組推動舞池的大型爵士編制。: A large jazz ensemble where saxophones, trumpets and trombones answer each other in sections while the rhythm section drives the dance floor.
以金貝鼓領奏、敦敦鼓提供固定循環的曼德鼓樂編制，為舞蹈而存在。: A Mande drumming line-up: the djembe leads, the dunun holds a fixed cycle, and the whole thing exists for the dance.
以長笛或薩克斯風、曼陀林、卡瓦基紐與吉他交織對位的巴西室內合奏傳統。: A Brazilian chamber tradition where flute or saxophone, mandolin, cavaquinho and guitar weave counterpoint.
以青銅敲擊樂器為主體、由一個整體調音支撐的印尼合奏傳統。: An Indonesian ensemble tradition built on bronze percussion and held together by one shared tuning.
以鼓、貝斯、吉他、主唱為核心，靠擴音與固定編制塑造聲響的流行樂團。: A pop band of drums, bass, guitar and lead vocal, shaping its sound with amplification and a fixed line-up.
以鼓樂、節慶、儀式或隊伍節奏為核心的編制。沒有旋律主奏時，時間怎麼被組織起來。: Line-ups built on drumming, festivals, ritual or the rhythm of a procession — how time is organised when no melody leads.
伯南布哥狂歡節的遊行編制，以領唱呼叫串起歌手、鼓群與舞者。: A carnival parade line-up from Pernambuco, where the lead singer's call threads singers, drums and dancers together.
兩把小提琴、中提琴、大提琴，四個平等聲部、沒有指揮的室內樂編制。: Two violins, viola and cello: four equal parts, no conductor.
兩把小號、法國號、長號、低音號，五件銅管用音域與管形撐起的室內樂編制。: Two trumpets, horn, trombone and tuba: five brass instruments held together by range and by the shape of their bores.
制度化、有指揮、有固定曲目的大型與室內編制。: Institutional large and chamber line-ups, with a conductor and a fixed repertoire.
加勒比・紐約與波多黎各: Caribbean · New York and Puerto Rico
台灣・中國與東南亞華人圈: Taiwan · Chinese-speaking communities in China and Southeast Asia
台灣漢人聚落中以嗩吶、鑼鼓與弦樂組成的業餘合奏傳統，分西皮與福祿兩系統。: An amateur ensemble tradition of Taiwan's Han settlements — suona, gongs and drums, strings — in two systems, Xipi and Fulu.
因錄音、媒體、場館或當代藝術而生的混合編制。: Hybrid line-ups that exist because of recording, media, venues or contemporary art.
在酒館裡圍坐合奏、以曲組串接的愛爾蘭傳統樂隊，與為舞蹈而設的 céilí ban: Sessions around a table in the pub, sets of tunes strung together — and the céilí band built for dancing.
巴爾幹半島・塞爾維亞與北馬其頓: The Balkans · Serbia and North Macedonia
把不同傳統的樂器放上同一個舞台，靠改編與調音折衷運作的跨界編制。: A crossover line-up that puts instruments from different traditions on one stage, working through compromises in arrangement and tuning.
把傳統樂器按交響樂團方式分組、擴充音域後組成的大型合奏。: A large ensemble that groups traditional instruments the way a symphony orchestra does, after extending their range.
把傳統樂器整理成現代樂團格式之後的產物。這一類的張力都在「改良」與「原貌」之間。: What you get when traditional instruments are reorganised into a modern orchestra. The tension in this group always runs between 'improved' and 'as it was'.
把原聲樂器即時擴音與處理、並與預錄音軌對時的混合編制，音響師是團員之一。: A hybrid line-up that amplifies and processes acoustic instruments live and keeps them in time with pre-recorded tracks; the sound engineer is one of the members.
把日本各種太鼓組成合奏的編制，從祭典行列到舞台演出。: The various Japanese taiko drums put together as an ensemble, from festival processions to the concert stage.
日本宮廷傳承的古老合奏，以笙、篳篥、龍笛與打擊樂構成。: The old court ensemble of Japan — sho, hichiriki, ryuteki and percussion.
森巴學校的遊行打擊隊，以蘇爾多鼓的分工撐起整所學校的歌唱與舞步。: The parade percussion of a samba school; the division of surdo parts holds up the whole school's singing and dancing.
樂器如何分工，聲音如何被組織成一個整體: How instruments divide the work, and how a sound becomes one whole
歐美・音樂劇產業: Europe and USA · musical theatre industry
沒有弦樂、以單簧管與薩克斯風重建聲部層次的大型管樂編制。: A large wind ensemble with no strings, rebuilding the section layers out of clarinets and saxophones.
為影像錄音的臨時管弦樂團，靠讀譜速度、節拍器與隔離錄音在錄音棚裡完成配樂。: An ad hoc orchestra recording to picture, getting the score down in the studio through sight-reading speed, a click track and isolated recording.
為舞台動作現場演奏的小型樂團，以提示點與場次而非歌曲結構組織音樂。: A small band playing live for stage action, organising the music by cues and scene numbers rather than by song structure.
英美・流行音樂工業: UK and USA · pop music industry
藏在舞台下方、用固定小編制與兼奏樂器撐起整齣音樂劇的職業合奏。: A professional ensemble hidden below the stage, carrying a whole musical with a fixed small band and doubling instruments.
街頭、民俗與社群生活中的樂隊編制。多半與舞蹈、節慶或特定地區的職業傳統綁在一起。: Band line-ups from the street, folk life and community occasions — usually tied to dance, a festival, or a region's professional tradition.
這一區談的不是單一樂器，而是: This section is not about a single instrument but about—
：誰管時間、誰管低音、誰帶旋律、樂手之間靠什麼協調。目前收錄 40 種編制，分成: : who keeps time, who carries the bass, who leads the melody, and how the players coordinate. 40 line-ups so far, in seven categories.
